workarounds.symptom: Interrupting `EvoSci deploy` shutdown can leave the server running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(deploy): always stop the deploy server, and let EvoSci server stop end one its deploy left. Target files: EvoScientist/cli/server_cmd.py, EvoScientist/deploy/server.py, EvoScientist/langgraph_dev/manager.py. . Part of #796. (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/812)

workarounds.symptom: On Windows, file tools refuse drive paths inside the workspace and put Git Bash paths in a nested folder
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(files): let Windows file tools take drive and Git Bash paths. Target files: EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py, EvoScientist/backends.py, EvoScientist/middleware/__init__.py. On Windows the agent's shell and Python print host paths: `[REDACTED]\...` (Python, `$PWD`), `C:\Users/me/...` (Git Bash `pwd`), `[REDACTED]/...` (`pwd -W`) or `/c[REDACTED]/...` (`realpath`, `readlink -f`, `$HOME`).
